name: 45 degree bicycle twisting crunch
side_note: Both sides alternate; both oblique sides are combined training-emphasis proxies.
muscle_notice: Illustrative training emphasis; not measured phase recruitment. Both oblique sides represent the combined superficial/deep group.

arms: Open elbows, light fingers behind the occiput, hands do not pull the neck.

name: 90 degree heel touch
side_note: Both sides alternate; both oblique sides are combined training-emphasis proxies.
muscle_notice: Illustrative training emphasis; not measured phase recruitment. Both oblique sides represent the combined superficial/deep group.
interpretation: Supine shoulder lift with fixed airborne approximately90degree hips/knees; alternating ipsilateral reach toward each heel.
arms: Open hands extend toward the raised heel; opposite hand remains alongside torso.
